Test Case Name: Verify RBC Floorplan availability for applicable policy line
Description: Validate that RBC Floorplan is displayed after the configured policy line is selected
Action: 1. Open policy setup; 2. Select the applicable policy line [TBD]; 3. Open coverage options
Expected Result: 1. Policy setup opens; 2. The applicable policy line is selected; 3. RBC Floorplan is visible and available for selection

Test Case Name: Select RBC Floorplan coverage
Description: Validate that the user can select the RBC Floorplan option
Action: 1. Select the applicable policy line [TBD]; 2. Open coverage options; 3. Select RBC Floorplan
Expected Result: RBC Floorplan becomes selected and the configuration area is available

Test Case Name: Enter valid floorplan details
Description: Validate that all configured required floorplan fields accept valid values
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter valid values in every required floorplan field [TBD]; 3. Move focus out of each field
Expected Result: Each field accepts the valid value and no validation error is displayed

Test Case Name: Proceed with valid RBC Floorplan configuration
Description: Validate that a completed valid configuration allows the policy workflow to continue
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Complete all required fields with valid data; 3. Click Continue or Next
Expected Result: The system validates the configuration and allows the user to proceed

Test Case Name: Save selected RBC Floorplan details
Description: Validate that valid RBC Floorplan data is saved during policy setup
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter valid required details; 3. Click Save or Continue; 4. Return to the RBC Floorplan section
Expected Result: The RBC Floorplan selection and entered details remain saved

Test Case Name: Display RBC Floorplan details in policy summary
Description: Validate that saved RBC Floorplan information appears accurately in the policy summary
Action: 1. Complete and save a valid RBC Floorplan configuration; 2. Open the policy summary
Expected Result: The summary displays RBC Floorplan as selected and shows the saved details accurately

Test Case Name: Update saved RBC Floorplan details
Description: Validate that the user can modify and save an existing configuration
Action: 1. Open a saved policy with RBC Floorplan; 2. Edit a configurable floorplan field; 3. Save the changes; 4. Open the policy summary
Expected Result: The updated value is saved and the policy summary shows the latest value

Test Case Name: Retain RBC Floorplan selection while navigating within policy setup
Description: Validate that navigation does not discard a saved valid configuration
Action: 1. Save valid RBC Floorplan details; 2. Navigate to the next policy setup screen; 3. Navigate back to the RBC Floorplan section
Expected Result: RBC Floorplan remains selected and the saved details are displayed

Test Case Name: Verify RBC Floorplan is unavailable before policy line selection
Description: Validate that the option is not offered before the applicable policy line is selected
Action: 1. Open policy setup; 2. Do not select a policy line; 3. Open or inspect coverage options
Expected Result: RBC Floorplan is unavailable or cannot be selected until the applicable policy line is chosen

Test Case Name: Verify RBC Floorplan availability is restricted to applicable policy line
Description: Validate that the option is not displayed for a non-applicable policy line
Action: 1. Open policy setup; 2. Select a non-applicable policy line [TBD]; 3. Open coverage options
Expected Result: RBC Floorplan is not available for the non-applicable policy line

Test Case Name: Attempt to proceed without selecting RBC Floorplan
Description: Validate required selection behavior when the applicable policy line is selected but RBC Floorplan is not selected
Action: 1. Select the applicable policy line; 2. Leave RBC Floorplan unselected; 3. Click Continue or Next
Expected Result: The system prevents progression if RBC Floorplan selection is required and displays the configured validation message

Test Case Name: Attempt to proceed with a missing required floorplan field
Description: Validate that an empty required field blocks progression
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Leave one required field [TBD] empty; 3. Complete other required fields; 4. Click Continue or Next
Expected Result: The empty field is identified with a validation message and the workflow does not proceed

Test Case Name: Attempt to proceed with all required floorplan fields empty
Description: Validate that the form rejects a completely empty RBC Floorplan configuration
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Leave all required floorplan fields empty; 3. Click Continue or Next
Expected Result: Validation messages identify the missing required information and progression is blocked

Test Case Name: Reject invalid floorplan detail format
Description: Validate that a value not matching the configured field format is rejected
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter an invalid value in a format-constrained field [TBD]; 3. Click Continue or Next
Expected Result: The invalid field displays a validation message and the policy cannot proceed

Test Case Name: Prevent summary display for unsaved invalid details
Description: Validate that invalid or incomplete data is not presented as a completed policy configuration
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter incomplete or invalid details; 3. Attempt to open or continue to the policy summary
Expected Result: The system blocks completion and does not show the invalid configuration as saved in the summary

Test Case Name: Cancel RBC Floorplan configuration
Description: Validate that cancelling an unsaved selection does not save the option
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter temporary details; 3. Click Cancel or leave without saving; 4. Reopen the policy section
Expected Result: The unsaved RBC Floorplan selection and temporary details are not persisted

Test Case Name: Submit each required field with its minimum valid value
Description: Validate configured minimum boundaries for all required floorplan fields
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter the minimum valid value for each required field [TBD]; 3. Continue
Expected Result: Each minimum valid value is accepted and the policy can proceed when all other requirements are satisfied

Test Case Name: Reject each required field below its minimum valid value
Description: Validate configured lower-bound validation for required floorplan fields
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter a value below the minimum for one required field [TBD]; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The out-of-range field is rejected and progression is blocked

Test Case Name: Submit each required field with its maximum valid value
Description: Validate configured maximum boundaries for all required floorplan fields
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter the maximum valid value for each required field [TBD]; 3. Continue
Expected Result: Each maximum valid value is accepted and the policy can proceed when all other requirements are satisfied

Test Case Name: Reject each required field above its maximum valid value
Description: Validate configured upper-bound validation for required floorplan fields
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter a value above the maximum for one required field [TBD]; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The out-of-range field is rejected and progression is blocked

Test Case Name: Verify RBC Floorplan selection state
Description: Validate the visible selected and unselected states of the RBC Floorplan control
Action: 1. Open applicable coverage options; 2. Observe RBC Floorplan before selection; 3. Select RBC Floorplan; 4. Observe the control
Expected Result: The control clearly changes from unselected to selected and the configuration fields become available

Test Case Name: Clear RBC Floorplan selection
Description: Validate that the user can remove the selection when the workflow permits it
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Enter valid details; 3. Clear or unselect RBC Floorplan
Expected Result: The option becomes unselected and dependent configuration fields are cleared or marked inactive according to the configured behavior

Test Case Name: Correct validation errors and continue
Description: Validate recovery after invalid required data is corrected
Action: 1. Select RBC Floorplan; 2. Leave a required field empty; 3. Attempt to continue; 4. Enter a valid value; 5. Continue again
Expected Result: The validation error is cleared after correction and the policy proceeds successfully

Test Case Name: Return from policy summary to RBC Floorplan configuration
Description: Validate navigation from the summary back to editable RBC Floorplan details
Action: 1. Save valid RBC Floorplan details; 2. Open policy summary; 3. Select the edit link or navigation control for RBC Floorplan
Expected Result: The RBC Floorplan configuration screen opens with the saved values populated

Test Case Name: Verify saved and unsaved RBC Floorplan states
Description: Validate that the UI distinguishes saved configuration from pending changes
Action: 1. Open a saved policy with RBC Floorplan; 2. Change a detail without saving; 3. Inspect the page and summary; 4. Save the change; 5. Inspect the summary again
Expected Result: Before saving, the pending change is not represented as the saved summary value; after saving, the updated value is displayed
